name: ChartPNG: weekly Stripe revenue to Slack

parameters.content:
### How it works
Every Monday at 09:00 this workflow reads the last 12 whole weeks of paid invoices from Stripe, adds them up by week and posts a KPI card to Slack: last week's revenue, the change on the week before and a 12-week sparkline. The chart is a PNG that ChartPNG (chartpng.dev) draws from a Chart.js config in the image URL, so Slack shows it like any image and nothing is uploaded.

The figure is an approximation, not MRR: the sum of paid invoices by the week they were created (UTC), tax included, with no proration, refunds or churn. With several currencies the chart uses the one with the most revenue, and the note under it counts the invoices left out. The workflow only reads from Stripe.

### Setup
1. Create a Stripe API credential and select it in **List paid invoices**. Stripe recommends a restricted key that can only read; n8n documents the secret key, so keep that as the fallback.
2. Create a Slack credential and select it in **Post to Slack**. With a bot token, invite the app to the channel.
3. In **Settings**, set `slackChannelId` to the channel ID (channel details in Slack, at the bottom).
4. Run the workflow once, check the message in Slack, then activate it.

### Customization
Change `weeks` and `chartTitle` in **Settings**. Without a ChartPNG key the image carries a small chartpng.dev watermark; a signed URL removes it: https://chartpng.dev/docs#signed-urls. Guide: https://chartpng.dev/guides/stripe-mrr-to-slack

## When and how far back
Runs every Monday at 09:00 in the workflow timezone. **Settings** holds what you change; **Date range** turns `weeks` into whole weeks, Monday to Sunday, in UTC.

## Read Stripe
One GET of paid invoices in the window, 100 per page, up to 20 pages. Read-only.

## Build the chart
Sums each week in one currency and builds the ChartPNG image URL and the Slack blocks, with alt text. Stops with a clear error when there is nothing to chart.

## Post to Slack
A header, the chart as an image block and a note on what the figure includes.
